headline: Make setup-aware AI planning selective instead of wasting moves

changes.title: Require setup moves to repay their daily-move opportunity cost
changes.detail: The first exact-engine benchmark exercised 37 setup moves but revealed a Chapter 3 regression. The diagnostic planner now penalizes nonmatching actions, conditionally explores them, and compares them with a same-horizon match-only alternative before choosing.

changes.title: Correct planner report assertion and document the experimental regression
changes.detail: The report-only integration test now matches the actual report heading rather than an obsolete phrase. The diagnostic documentation records the measured regression, the candidate count, and the reasons for cautious setup selection.
